text:
alex: Quick sync re: last night's latency spikes — we need owners and timelines for remediation, dashboards, and any SLO/SLA adjustments.

maria: Yup. Error budget burned ~3.6% for prod cluster-1 overnight per the incident post. Link: <https://incidents.redwood/example/2026-03-22|incident-2026-03-22>.

jamal: Looking at traces, most of the spike is p95 tokens/seq when seq > 1024, coincident with a GC pause on the model server pool.

liz: GC tune + limit max seq length per request? We discussed prioritizing smart batching but need quick guardrails.

sre-bot: Deployments: rollout-2026-03-22-2 completed 03:12 UTC; alerting: latency-p95-prod fired 03:05 UTC (x6).

alex: Proposed immediate actions: 1) short-term mitigation (limit seq to 1024 for now), 2) infra fix (GC tuning + JVM flags) & perf test, 3) dashboard updates and alert threshold tweak, 4) SLO review for p95/p99 windows. Who owns each?

maria: I can take dashboard/alerts. ETA EOD tomorrow to add a per-model p95 panel, error-budget burn trend, and a runbook link.

jamal: I'll own infra fix + perf test. Plan: apply GC config to canary pool, run 4h load test, validate KV cache behavior. ETA: canary change tomorrow morning, perf test by tomorrow afternoon.

liz: I'll put a short-term gateway limiter to cap seq >1024 with a warning response code. Small PR now, canary in 30m.

alex: For SLOs — I suggest we don't change the target yet, but add a temporary SLA note and tighten alert windows: alert if sustained p95 > 200ms for 10m (was 30m). I'll draft proposed SLO doc and share in #eng-sre for review. Owner: alex, ETA: Thursday EOD.

product-ops: If we end up changing SLA language, let us know. For now we'll prep an advisory template in case customer notices latency.

jamal: Monitoring queries to add to dashboard (PromQL):
```
max_over_time(redwood_inference_latency_p95{env="prod"}[1h])
rate(redwood_error_budget_burn_total[1h])
```
Include p95 by model tag.

maria: Noted. I'll also add a rolling 7d error budget sparklines per customer tier.

alex: Action items (quick):
- infra fix: jamal - canary tomorrow morning, perf test tomorrow afternoon - status: in progress
- gateway limiter: liz - PR -> canary in 30m - status: in progress
- dashboards/alerts: maria - ETA EOD tomorrow - status: assigned
- SLO doc + recommendation: alex - ETA Thu EOD - status: draft upcoming
- Customer comms template: product-ops - standby - status: on-hold

liz: I'll post the gateway PR link here once canary is up.

jamal: After perf test, if p95 still elevated for seq>1024 we'll consider model quantization path. Noting recurring pattern: similar spikes on 2026-02-10 and 2026-01-05 — may be workload growth + longer sequences.

alex: Good catch on recurrence. Let's add a follow-up retro item: correlate sequence length distribution over last 90 days and evaluate a quota or heuristic to suggest shorter requests. Owner: jamal + maria. ETA for analysis: next Tuesday.

maria: I'll add the 90d seq-dist panel to the dashboard so we can spot trends quickly.

alex: Thanks all — we'll reconvene in the scheduled SLO sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC. If anything changes faster, update this thread. :thumbsup:
